name: Typed kicker
purpose: A small label (scene number, place, date) that types on character by character with a caret, and can erase and retype to the next label in the same box, as the cloud, Korea and fridge films each hand-coded.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: One label, or several that share one box (the box never reflows)

inputs.name: cps
inputs.description: Characters per second; erasing runs 2.5 times faster

inputs.name: caret
inputs.description: A caret follows the last typed character and blinks out after each pass

implementation.api: Studio.comp.kicker(parent, {text}, {cps, caret, blink}) -> {enter(tl, at), type(tl, index, at), exit(tl, at)}; call type() in time order

layout_notes: Inline element in the kicker type role (--fs-kicker, mono, uppercase); place it with the film's own header layout. aria-label keeps every label for screen readers.
validation_steps: python tests/test-studio-runtime.py (typing count, caret position, retype, backward seek)

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-24. Not rendered through HyperFrames.
